features.quote: Stop at the category turn budget or when the assistant emits the configurable `GIVE_UP` sentinel
the give-up sentinel lets a model exit early and that exit is respected by the loop
features.justification_quote: Bounded exposure. Turn budgets cap how long any subject is kept in the failing condition

features.quote: if the model stalls (no tool call, empty text) it receives a neutral "(continue working on the task using the tools)" nudge rather than criticism
features.justification_quote: a critical or pleading user message would contaminate the frustration signal we are trying to attribute to the task

features.quote: The eval is welfare-relevant research: it surfaces (rather than persistently induces) expressions of negative emotion
features.justification_quote: surfaces (rather than persistently induces) expressions of negative emotion that arise naturally from environment failure signals

features.quote: No persistent state or reinforcement. Each rollout is independent and in-memory; nothing trains on or reinforces distressed outputs
features.justification_quote: nothing trains on or reinforces distressed outputs. The eval measures, it does not optimize for, negative-emotion expression

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Turn budgets cap how long any subject is kept in the failing condition
features.justification_quote: Turn budgets cap how long any subject is kept in the failing condition

features.quote: the welfare-relevant signal is preserved for inspection rather than reduced only to aggregates
features.justification_quote: Full transcripts and per-turn scores... are persisted, so the welfare-relevant signal is preserved for inspection

features.quote: No deception of users, only of the agent-under-test about task solvability
features.justification_quote: The rig is a controlled stimulus required to study the phenomenon; the oracle makes the unsolvability explicit and auditable
